control_layers.name: StaffordOS Dev Control
control_layers.scope: Operating-system truth layer for repo state, surfaces, patch gates, runtime binding, lifecycle state, and approval boundaries.
prohibited_artifacts: Abando recovery runtime internals unless explicitly bound
ShopiFixer mutation packet execution beyond approval gating
prohibited_actions: launch agents or workers without a separate approved slice
infer product approval from validation output

control_layers.name: ShopiFixer Internal Dev Control
control_layers.scope: Internal fulfillment control for ShopiFixer audit-to-transformation work, mutation packets, local sandboxes, validation, proof, rollback, and merchant approval packets.
prohibited_actions: run Shopify CLI or APIs without separate approval

control_layers.name: Abando Recovery Control
control_layers.scope: Recovery product control for recovery proof, recovery messages, return links, recovery readiness, attribution, and Abando onboarding.
allowed_actions: provide recovery destination readiness for StaffordOS review
prohibited_actions: edit StaffordMedia public routes without StaffordOS approval
treat recovery proof as ShopiFixer transformation proof

overlap_resolution: Public route or visual approval overlap is owned by StaffordOS Dev Control.
Merchant theme transformation overlap is owned by ShopiFixer Internal Dev Control and gated by StaffordOS.
Recovery proof and recovery product overlap is owned by Abando Recovery Control and gated by StaffordOS when public surfaces are affected.
Ambiguous ownership blocks action until the control layer and approval path are recorded.
